User.title: User
User.description: Registered application user with role-based access control (main_admin, admin_advisor, or user).

assignedAdvisorId.description: Assigned advisor UID if role is user

deviceInfo.description: Device name or client user-agent summary

lastLoginAt.description: ISO timestamp of most recent login

createdAt.description: ISO timestamp when account was created

Transaction.title: Transaction
Transaction.description: Financial income or expense transaction belonging to a user.

category.description: Category name for budgeting and allocation

date.description: Date of transaction formatted as YYYY-MM-DD

note.description: Optional memo or description for the transaction

isRecurring.description: Whether this is a recurring monthly transaction

FinancialData.title: FinancialData
FinancialData.description: Aggregated user portfolio data including assets, liabilities, accounts, envelopes, and goals.

assets.description: List of user assets with market valuations

liabilities.description: List of debts, mortgages, loans, and EMIs

essentialGoals.description: Emergency funds, insurance, and core reserves

customGoals.description: Life goals, car, house, retirement targets

updatedAt.description: ISO timestamp of last cloud synchronization

AdvisorAssignment.title: AdvisorAssignment
AdvisorAssignment.description: Maintains 1:10 client mapping for an admin advisor.

assignedUserIds.description: List of user UIDs assigned to this advisor (max 10)

currentClientCount.description: Current number of assigned users (0 to 10)

updatedAt.description: ISO timestamp of last assignment change

Feedback.title: Feedback
Feedback.description: User feedback, suggestions, reviews, and bug reports routed to the admin panel.

userId.description: UID of user who submitted feedback

adminNotes.description: Internal notes added by admin or advisor

createdAt.description: ISO timestamp when feedback was sent

/users/{userId}.description: User profiles and RBAC role assignments.

/users/{userId}/transactions/{transactio.description: Persistent individual financial transactions for each user.

/users/{userId}/financial_data/{docId}.description: User's persistent assets, liabilities, budgets, and goals snapshot.

/feedback/{feedbackId}.description: Feedback and support tickets routed to Main Admin and Advisors.
